The task type tells the forms apart, and the answer follows the form of the request. Other task types answer ERROR_TASK_NOT_SUPPORTED. See Migrating from CapSolver, Migrating from CapMonster Cloud and Migrating from 2Captcha. The call waits for the answer, up to 15 seconds, and returns it as solution. If it takes longer, the status is processing and you fetch the answer with getTaskResult. Keys, limits and billing are the same as on the other paths: a task is charged once, when its solution is returned.

If processing takes longer, returns status "processing" - poll with getTaskResult to retrieve the answer. Unsupported task types return ERROR_TASK_NOT_SUPPORTED. Billing occurs once when the solution is returned.
